Midnight Tavern bar sound effects

The following Freesound recordings are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
The game uses trimmed mono excerpts with adjusted gain and fades.

Ice — Ice moving in glass, by Rvgerxini
https://freesound.org/people/Rvgerxini/sounds/464451/

Stir — Water stirred in glass with metal spoon, by Tom_Kaszuba
https://freesound.org/people/Tom_Kaszuba/sounds/657552/

Pour — Pouring water into a glass, by astonedf
https://freesound.org/people/astonedf/sounds/841426/

Potion drop — Drips_PipetteDripFast_3_SFX, by hanasmusic
https://freesound.org/people/hanasmusic/sounds/841481/

Garnish — Glass Tap, by zembacraftworks
https://freesound.org/people/zembacraftworks/sounds/427389/
